name: Youves uUSD
oneLiner: uUSD is Youves's overcollateralized CDP dollar on Tezos, minted against XTZ, tzBTC, USDt, or SIRS at collateral-specific target ratios with a savings pool.
collateral: Overcollateralized by XTZ, tzBTC, USDt, or SIRS (tez/tzBTC LP); target ratios vary by collateral (200% for XTZ, 115% for stablecoins); 300% applied only to legacy v1/v2 vaults
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP on Tezos with variable collateral ratios; liquidations triggered at emergency ratio with 12.5% reward; savings pool provides additional peg stability

oracleRisk.summary: Youves states uUSD uses the ubinetic oracle service with independent third-party transmitters and standardized oracle feeds.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: UUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: uUSD is minted by Youves vaults on Tezos: users lock XTZ/tzBTC/USDt/SIRS collateral at collateral-specific target ratios to mint uUSD, and the Youves DAO contract (Murmuration-derived, YOU governance) is set as administrator over the minting engine, with a keyholder break-glass guardian.

controls.label: Youves minting engine / vault contracts
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by collateral-specific target ratios (e.g. ~200% XTZ, ~115% stablecoins) enforced by the Youves vault/engine with oracle-driven liquidation.
controls.evidence: Youves docs describe users opening vaults that lock collateral and mint uUSD against collateral-specific target ratios, with a price oracle setting liquidation thresholds.

controls.label: Youves DAO contract (YOU governance) + break-glass guardian
controls.evidence: Youves docs state the Murmuration-derived DAO contract is set as administrator over all Youves contracts (changing parameters via YOU-staker-voted Michelson lambdas), with a keyholder multisig retained as a break-glass guardian.

controls.label: FlatYouves DEX Admin — 4-of-7 Tezos multisig (admin of all three uUSD engines)
controls.evidence: At Tezos level 13594990, the admin of all three uUSD minting engines resolved to this 4-of-7 multisig via TzKT storage reads (Phase 0c continuation).

review.evidence: At Tezos level 13594990 (2026-06-11), TzKT bigmap reads of all three uUSD engine administrator bigmaps (7710, 22750, 75204) confirm KT1Q8yKdJaU5VcBL8JcxUT9PU99m53ubERk4 (FlatYouves DEX Admin) as the sole or primary admin across all engines; that contract's storage holds 7 Tezos public keys with threshold 4 (4-of-7 Tezos multisig, stored_counter=120). The uUSD token admin bigmap (7705) lists the three vault-creator / engine contracts as administrators. The Youves DAO governance token is KT1Xobej4mc6XgEjDoJoHtTKgbD1ELMvcQuL (YOU Governance). The relationship between the DAO governance contract and the engine admin (FlatYouves DEX Admin multisig) is not confirmed on-chain — the DAO is not directly wired as an engine admin; the 4-of-7 multisig appears to be the operative administrator. Promotion judgment: every mint-capable surface is confirmed — engines are cap-limited contracts and their shared admin is the confirmed 4-of-7 multisig. The DAO-vs-multisig governance relationship colors posture, not control confirmation (same standard as other verified multisig-admin coins).

sources.label: TzKT: uUSD engine KT1FFE2 admin bigmap

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: UUSD is tracked as a single-chain or natively issued asset for this review, with no source-verified cross-chain route that creates durable supply. Bridge-route scoring is therefore informational and does not add a third-party route penalty.
bridgeRouteRisk.sourceFreeRationale: The tracked UUSD contract is on Tezos and reviewed Youves docs describe local synthetic-asset contracts rather than a cross-chain route.
